text:
Oliver Grant: Hey team — excited to join platform today! Quick blocker: my SSO MFA keeps prompting and then times out during app login. Also Docker daemon permission denied when I try `docker build`. Anyone run into this on day 0? Also curious: do we have a designated lunch day for the platform crew? I can bring cookies.

Priya Rao: welcome Oliver! I'm your onboarding buddy. For MFA try removing the old device from your authenticator app and re-enrolling via https://sso.redwood.com/enroll. If that fails, ping @IT Support. Lunch: we usually do group order on Thursdays, rotating cuisines. Cookies = instant popularity. :cookie:

IT Support: Hi Oliver — can you run `authenticator-cli status` and paste the output (no codes)? Also run `sudo usermod -aG docker $USER` then log out/in to pick up the group change. If you see "permission denied", try `sudo systemctl start docker` first.

Oliver Grant: `authenticator-cli status` shows: device_registered: true, last_sync: failed. Tried `usermod` but still permission denied on docker. I hadn't restarted session yet.

DevOps Bot: Welcome logged for Oliver Grant. Onboarding checklist: sso_enrolled: pending, docker_group: pending, slack_invite: true.

Priya Rao: FYI sometimes the macOS keychain holds stale MFA tokens. If you're on mac, open Keychain Access and search for "redwood-sso" and delete old entries, then re-enroll.

Nora Lopez: also for Docker on mac, ensure Docker Desktop has "Expose daemon on tcp://localhost:2375" enabled if you need CLI-only flows. We prefer using the buildkite pipeline for heavier images.

Oliver Grant: I'm on macOS 13.6. Deleted the old keychain entries and re-enrolled MFA — success! Logged in to the web app. Re: Docker, restarted and now `sudo usermod` took effect after logout; can run builds now. Huge thanks.

IT Support: Verified sso_enrolled: true. Docker group updated: docker_group: true. Closing temporary ticket. If you hit any more perms issues tag me.

Priya Rao: great! I'll add you to #platform-alerts and give you the small first-week task (instrument a simple metric on the health-check endpoint). 1:1 at 3pm.

Oliver Grant: Awesome. Fun fact: I bake sourdough and once made 24 loaves for a hackathon breakfast. Can bring small samples next Thursday.

Samir Patel: that sounds legendary 44f. Thursday lunch + sourdough is a plan. Welcome aboard, Oliver!

HR Bot: Welcome to Redwood Inference, Oliver! Please complete benefits & payroll forms: https://redwood.inference/hr/onboard. Orientation at 9am in #all-hands.

Oliver Grant: Thanks everyone for the quick help and warm welcome. See you at 3pm and for lunch on Thursday!
